sources.title: Winners and Losers from the Denver Broncos’ 23-17 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers
sources.description: The Broncos are back to winning ugly! Ugly is the best way to describe this game. The Chargers played like a 0-4 team that has been decimated by injuries, while the Broncos continued to struggle on offense and had lapses on defense. However, despite the ugliness, the Broncos and quarterback Bo Nix led yet another […]
